list_all/listAll/Iter with limit 0 or negative clamps to ≥1 and terminates

str()/print/f-string/%s formatting (not only repr/inspect) of client, config, errors AND models carrying secrets (Webhook.secret) never contain the API key or secret; every object reachable from the client (resources, transport/http client) is covered — TS `private` is erased at runtime and Go %+v follows pointers
timestamp normalizer never raises for {seconds:1,nanoseconds:'q'}, {_seconds:1e300}, {seconds:-1e14}, {seconds:[1]} — field keeps a string form of the raw value
